description: K₂NaS₂O₆Cl crystallizes in the tetragonal P4/n space group. K is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to six O and two Cl atoms. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.78-3.00 Å. There is one shorter (3.10 Å) and one longer (3.12 Å) K-Cl bond length. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to four equivalent O and two equivalent Cl atoms to form corner-sharing NaCl₂O₄ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.48 Å. There is one shorter (2.71 Å) and one longer (2.79 Å) Na-Cl bond length. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to four equivalent O and two equivalent Cl atoms to form distorted corner-sharing NaCl₂O₄ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.33 Å. Both Na-Cl bond lengths are 2.75 Å. S is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.45 Å) and one longer (1.46 Å) S-O bond length. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one K, one Na, and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent K, one Na, and one S atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three equivalent K and one S atom. There are two inequivalent Cl sites. In the first Cl site, Cl is bonded to four equivalent K and two equivalent Na atoms to form distorted corner-sharing ClK₄Na₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-28°. In the second Cl site, Cl is bonded to four equivalent K and two equivalent Na atoms to form corner-sharing ClK₄Na₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-28°.
